threshold.label: VAD threshold
threshold.info: Probability above which a frame is classified as speech.

minSpeechDurationMs.label: Minimum speech duration (ms)
minSpeechDurationMs.info: Speech segments shorter than this are discarded as noise or false positives.

minSilenceDurationMs.label: Minimum silence duration (ms)
minSilenceDurationMs.info: Silence must last at least this long to end a speech segment. Shorter pauses are kept inside the segment.

maxSpeechDurationS.label: Maximum speech duration (s)
maxSpeechDurationS.info: Segments longer than this are split at silence points to keep individual chunks manageable.

speechPadMs.label: Speech padding (ms)
speechPadMs.info: Padding added before and after each detected segment so word edges are not clipped.

samplesOverlap.label: Samples overlap (s)
samplesOverlap.info: Audio carried from each segment into the next to avoid abrupt cuts when concatenating.
